book.name: 2Qoronttoosa
book.title: Phawuloosa Qoronttoosa Asayis Xaafeez Nam7intho Kiita

content: Ta yinttar yeza wode haayo, ma yinttipp haakkin nuul afa miinggiza yeegintteez, Phawuloosa, keehannee ashikke maaqqeez Kiristtoosa sunthar yinttan woosiza.
Taanii yinttiko yhanigodar nuna asho qofar yuuyiza as udii qoppiza asayil afa mino qaalar odinttodayis qopeeza. Yinttal afa yey garkk odinttoday garkk yi tana oothaamay garkk yinttan woosiza.
Nuunii yha sa7all yezikoka yha sa7a as garkk olinttaam.
Nu ola miishay yha sa7asa baaya. Zini mishshige laalodayis wolqqar yez Xooss toora.
Xooss eratithal afa dhube maaqqii denddizi palamannee utira qofa ubba laalloda. As qofa ubba di77i Kiristtoosas azazinttoday garkk oothoda.
Yi kiitinttay folo maaqqeez wode nuunii kiitintto ixo ubba seerodayis giigintteeza.
Yi bi7izay asho aafayir benttizaya. Oonkka fana Kiristtoosa bagga gi ammaninttii qoppizabaz maaqqiko, nuukka Kiristtoosa bagga maaqqeezana ero.
Goday taas inggeez mawuter ceeqinttikokka yeyid yeellataam. Ye mawutay taas inggintteezay yinttan dichchodayisapp attin qohodayis baaya.
Taanii ta xaafeez kiititayid yinttan yashishodayis koyii xaafeez baz yinttis aazippe.
Pettii pettii asay, «Phawuloosa xaafeez kiitay deexonnee wolqqama, zin eza bi7iza wode E daaburanchcha; e odaykka pathoowa baz» yeegiz aaziza.
Ye asitay nu haakko yezar xaafiza dabddaabbiyarannee ukke yinttar yezar oothiza oosay gancce dummatithii baazana akaako.
Nuunii fana sabiza asitayir nuna payidodayis woy qarasodayis koyooya. Zini unttii fana paar helithii woy qaras bi7ittar yezayir unttis akaakeeza aazippe.
Zini nuunii Xoossay nuus inggeez dhassayid ceeqinttinepp attin zawa aadhii ceeqinttooya; ye zaway yinttikokka heliza.
Nuunii beezizaypp aathii ceeqinttooya, zin Kiristtoosa Wonggile yinttiko heltheezayid ceeqinttoda.
Nuunii Xoossay esseez zawa piinggii, yhankkitay ootheez oosor ceeqinttaamii. Hano zin, yi ammanay diccoday garkk Xoossay inggeez zawayid yi gancce nu oothiza oosay dalggoda gi qoppiza.
Nuunii hara as fa zawayil ootheez oosol gelii ceeqinttekkar yinttipp piinggii haras Wonggile markkattodayis danda7iza.
Zini, Geeshsha Maxaafayid, «Ceeqqiza ubbay Godayil ceeqqo» yeegii xaafintteeza.
Goday nashshiza athaypp attin fana paas nashshiza athay nashinttooya.
